text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your fatigue, lower leg swelling, and weight loss, could you tell me how long you've been experiencing these symptoms? Have you noticed any shortness of breath or changes in your urine output?

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any shortness of breath, especially when lying flat, or have you noticed a decrease in your urine output? Given your history of chronic bronchitis, have you recently had any episodes of coughing up blood or increased sputum production?

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your significant smoking history, do you have any chest pain, fever, or cough up blood, and have you noticed any swelling in your abdomen or yellowing of your skin? To help narrow this down, REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count and Basic Metabolic Panel.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the right upper lobe mass found on your CT scan alongside your heavy smoking history, I suspect this lung tumor is causing your kidney issues through a paraneoplastic effect.
